attempts.sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.file_id = (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = '_client' AND package = 'httpx')
  AND s.kind = 'method'
  AND s.qualname NOT LIKE 'BaseClient.%'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM code.headings h
    WHERE h.file_id = s.file_id
      AND h.heading = s.name
      AND h.value IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(h.value) != ''
  );
